chunks: We surely know those of you who go forward and We surely know those of you who lag behind.

key_terms.الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ: Those who lag behind or are slow/hesitant
key_terms.الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ: Those who go forward or are eager/proactive

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between al-mustaqdimin and al-mustakhhirin in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Sad, this verse highlights Allah's omniscience regarding the varying degrees of spiritual readiness among the believers, specifically contrasting the proactive 'mustaqdimin' with the hesitant 'mustakhhirin'. Shia exegetes often view this distinction as a call to accelerate in righteous deeds to avoid the stagnation of the delayed, reinforcing the concept of spiritual urgency in the journey toward divine proximity.
